name: Champion Steel Works
old_description: Managing construction projects can be stressful. At Champion Steel Works, we deliver stress-free steel you can trust -- giving contractors the confidence and credibility to succeed.
about:
Champion Steel Works, operating in Wilmington, Ohio, traces its roots to 1872 when it began as Champion Bridge Company. The family-led business has been passed down through generations; current president Noah Dell succeeded his father, continuing a legacy of serving the community with integrity and gratitude.

The company fabricates structural steel, producing more than 60 tons per week at its Wilmington shop. Its services span steel fabrication, project management, job order contract (JOC) proposal support, and local metal supply. The process emphasizes early plan analysis, conflict identification, fabrication to specification, quality inspection, and scheduled delivery to match project timelines.

Champion serves contractors across Ohio, Kentucky, the Carolinas, Indiana, Tennessee, Michigan, Georgia, Alabama, and Florida, with projects including healthcare facilities such as Winton Hills Medical Center and a new medical office building. The firm also supplies metal to residents and businesses throughout Clinton County.

The company differentiates itself through a predictable, four-step process designed to eliminate guesswork and deliver “stress-free steel.” Its multi-generational family values — hard work, community building, and integrity — underpin a reputation built on 154 years and over 8,400 contracts awarded.
